title: Tigana
html:
Tigana are a bodiless race of demons that dwell in the blackness beyond the Rim. The Tigana are able to inhabit human hosts and are able to traverse through shadow. One has been following Moorlin since his arrival on shadow Earth and has taken many forms. At one time posing as Gail, girlfriend to Mark. Other appearances include Dan Martinez, Daiana Blake and Nayda. Secundus states that they are very powerful and difficult to control and the Tigana in this story is sent to protect Moorlin by his mother O'Briain. The spell placed on the Tigana prevented the demon from letting Moorlin know who sent it. However, this directive was over ridden when the demon saw the Eye of the Serpent and the demon attempted to steal the jewel but was stopped by Spiritcircle. The Tigana was unable the vacate the body of Nayda because the spirit has already left the body.
